ambient_events: The lift chimes on a floor somewhere below and does not stop here.
A door releases down the gallery, seals, and the carpet takes the rest.
The arrangement on the console table is, impossibly, always at its best hour.
description: The higher gallery, and the building knows the difference: the same panelled walnut and swallowing carpet as the floor below, but fewer doors, wider apart, and a window at the end that gives the bay, the mountains and the weather coming off both. A console table carries an arrangement that is changed, not watered. Three private residences open off this landing: north, east, and west. Step in to the elevator.
name: Solenne Residences — The Upper Residences
